ingredients.name: cannellini beans
ingredients.line: 1 (15 oz) can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: kidney beans
ingredients.line: 1 (15 oz) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: garbanzo beans
ingredients.line: 1 (15 oz) can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.line: 1/2 red onion, chopped fine, soaked in water

ingredients.name: granulated sugar
ingredients.line: 1/4 cup granulated sugar (more or less to taste)

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix the 3 different types of beans, the celery, onion (drained of soaking water), parsley, and rosemary.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, sugar, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the dressing to the beans. Toss to coat.
Chill for several hours to allow the beans to soak up the flavor of the dressing.

ingredients.name: garbanzo beans
ingredients.line: 1/2 cup garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Toast pita and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Toss all ingredients together and serve.
Cook Rice-A-Roni as directed on box.
Cut and drain olives, water chestnuts, chicken, and artichoke hearts.
Add to Rice-A-Roni.
Mix together in a bowl with mayonnaise.
Refrigerate until ready to eat.

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.line: 1/2 (10 oz) pkg spinach, torn and well drained

steps.text: Arrange all but sour cream and mayonnaise in layers in a large bowl. Repeat salt, pepper, and sugar between layers.
Mix Sour cream and mayonnaise and spread over the top, making sure sour cream and mayo go out to edge of salad.
Top with grated or shredded Swiss cheese. Sprinkle with Bacon.
Place the cucumbers, tomatoes, onion, and basil in a large bowl and toss.
Mix remaining ingredients in a small bowl; stir to combine well and drizzle over salad.

ingredients.name: sweet basil dressing
ingredients.note: can leave out if using avocado
ingredients.line: sweet basil dressing (can leave out if using avocado)

steps.text: Cook + Chill Pasta.
Slice olives and red peppers.
Combine all to taste.

ingredients.name: large chicken breasts
ingredients.line: 3 large chicken breasts, boiled and shredded

ingredients.name: Cha-Cha Chinese Chicken Salad dressing
ingredients.line: 3/4 cup Cha-Cha Chinese Chicken Salad dressing

steps.text: Mix cha-cha Salad dressing with chicken. Chill well.
Deep fry rice sticks in medium hot oil (be prepared to remove rice almost immediately, as they puff up very quickly).
Mix together all salad ingredients except rice sticks and chicken.
The rice sticks and chicken should be added just before serving. Toss well.

recipes.title: Harvest Salad

ingredients.name: shaved Brussels sprouts
ingredients.line: 1 lb shaved Brussels sprouts, stems removed

steps.text: Shred the Brussels sprouts into 1/16" shreds using a food processor shredder attachment, a mandoline, or a knife.
Combine the Brussels sprouts, pomegranate, apple, pecans, cranberries, and Parmesan in a bowl.
Whisk together all of the dressing ingredients, pour over the salad, and toss.
Let the salad sit for at least 30 min before serving. As it sits, the acid in the dressing will soften the sprouts.
Add everything except the pecans to a saucepan over medium heat and stir well, heating for 1 min.
Add the pecans and stir well, then cook for 3-5 min over medium heat, stirring often, until the glaze thickens and cooks down. It should look shiny and thick (if it's not thick, they will not set).
Transfer to parchment paper to cool completely before breaking up.

notes: The shaved Brussels sprouts can be substituted with a mix of arugula and spinach.
The candied pecans can be replaced with toasted walnuts.

steps.text: In blender add all ingredients & blend. Use 1/2 to whole onion.
Blend til mixed and to desired consistency.
Melt butter in an 11x13 pan.
Beat eggs and add all else.
Bake at 400°F for 15 min, then at 350°F for 30 min.
Brown beef with onions. Add salt, pepper, chili powder. Add tomato sauce.
Crush Chips.
Layer twice: meat, Sour Cream, chips, cheese.
Put most of the cheese on top.

ingredients.name: Romano or Parmesan cheese
ingredients.line: 3 Tbsp Romano or Parmesan cheese, grated

steps.text: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs.
Place in loaf pan.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 325°F for 1 hr.
Mix ingredients; shape into 20 1/2" balls.
Cook over medium heat, turning occasionally until brown, about 20 min.
Or bake in ungreased oblong pan (13x9) at 400°F for 20-25 min.
Wash rice.
Combine all ingredients but last 4 in slow cooker, mix well.
Cover and cook on Low 4-6 hrs.
Serve with last 4 ingredients.
Grease a 1 1/2 qt baking dish.
Beat eggs with flour, milk, baking powder and spices.
Mix with Chilies and 2/3 of cheese.
Pour into pan then Sprinkle with remainder of cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 30 min.

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.line: 1-2 bunches broccoli, cut and partially cooked

steps.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes and put in 9x13 pan.
Put broccoli and rice on top.
Mix Chicken soup, mayonnaise, Curry powder and lemon juice then pour over broccoli and rice.
Sprinkle with Cheese and bread crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350°F for 40 min.
Serve with Dinner Rolls and Green Salad.
Mix together salt, pepper, herbs, and garlic powder.
Heat oil on stove and add chicken, sprinkling each side with the herb mix.
Heat on med/low Covered flipping the chicken breasts halfway through.

ingredients.name: medium potatoes
ingredients.line: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes

steps.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Saute onion until lightly browned.
Stir in garlic, ginger, curry powder, cinnamon, cumin powder, chili powder, sugar and salt. Continue stirring for 2 min.
Add coconut milk, potatoes, carrots and chicken.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 min.

ingredients.name: sharp American or Swiss cheese
ingredients.line: 16 oz sharp American or Swiss cheese

steps.text: Cook macaroni.
Cook and stir butter, onion, salt, and pepper until onion is slightly tender.
Blend in flour. Cook over low heat. Stir constantly. Boil 1 min.
Remove from heat and stir in milk and cheese until melted.
Place macaroni in ungreased 3 qt Casserole dish, stir in cheese sauce.
Bake at 375°F for 30 min.

ingredients.name: small chicken breasts
ingredients.line: 3 small chicken breasts, cooked and sliced

steps.text: Combine salsa, miracle whip, and chili powder.
Spread on bottom halves of tortillas.
Top with chicken and cheese.
Fold tortillas in half to enclose.
Cook in skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium heat 4-5 min on each side or until both sides are golden and cheese is melted.
Cut each quesadilla into 3 wedges to serve.
Combine hashbrowns, chicken soup, sour cream, cheddar cheese, green onions, salt and pepper.
Pour mixture into Casserole dish.
Melt butter and mix with Crushed corn flakes.
Sprinkle over mixture in casserole dish.
Bake uncovered at 350°F for 45-60 min.
Pour potato mixture into Crockpot.
Broil cornflakes and butter until brown and crispy.
Sprinkle over mixture in crock pot.
Cook on High 3-4 hrs.
Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Sprinkle bacon, cheese, and onion in pie crust.
Beat eggs slightly, beat in remaining ingredients.
Pour egg mixture into pie crust.
Bake uncovered at 425°F for 15 min.
Reduce temp to 300°F and bake uncovered until knife comes out clean (30 min).
Let stand 10 min before taking out.
Brown beef in skillet and drain off fat.
Put in Crockpot; add remaining ingredients.
Stir thoroughly. Cover and cook.
Cook on Low 8-10 hrs or High 3-4 hrs.
For hamburgers, combine first 6 ingredients. Toss together lightly; don't overmix.
Shape into 8 thin patties.
For filling, cut ripe olives into medium sized pieces and combine with remaining ingredients.
Spread 4 hamburger patties with relish and top with remaining patties.
Cook on grill, broiler, or in pan.
Arrange chicken in slow cooker.
Combine remaining ingredients, pour over chicken.
Cover and cook.
Cook on High 4-5 hrs or Low 7-8 hrs.
Brown Burger.
Add tomato Sauce + Sugar.
Let Simmer for a few min.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.line: 8 oz boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch chunks

ingredients.name: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.line: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.name: half and half
ingredients.line: 1/2 cup half and half (or more, as needed)

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large stockpot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, to taste. Add chicken to the stockpot and cook until golden, about 2-3 min; set aside.

Melt butter in the stockpot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add garlic, mushrooms, onion, carrots and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 3-4 min. Stir in thyme until fragrant, about 1 min.
Whisk in flour until lightly browned, about 1 min. Whisk in chicken stock, bay leaf and chicken thighs, and cook, whisking constantly, until slightly thickened, about 4-5 min.
Stir in half and half until heated through, about 1-2 min; season with salt and pepper, to taste. If the soup is too thick, add more half and half as needed until desired consistency is reached.
Serve immediately, garnished with parsley and rosemary, if desired.

ingredients.name: medium eggplants
ingredients.line: 3 medium eggplants (about 3 1/2 lb total), sliced crosswise into 1/2"-thick rounds

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.line: 1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper, plus more

ingredients.name: Pecorino or Parmesan
ingredients.line: 2 oz Pecorino or Parmesan, finely grated (about 1 3/4 cups) (divided)

ingredients.name: large egg yolks
ingredients.line: 3 large egg yolks, beaten to blend

steps.text: Preheat oven to 475°F with the rack in the middle. Whisk half the garlic, 1/2 cup oil, 1 Tbsp mint and 1 Tbsp oregano; brush on the eggplant rounds, season, and roast on a rimmed sheet 35-45 min. Reduce oven to 400°F.
Heat 2 Tbsp oil in a large pot; brown the lamb 12-16 min. Strain the fat and reserve 3 Tbsp.

In the pot, heat 2 Tbsp lamb fat; cook the onion, cinnamon stick, 2 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper 8-10 min. Add the chiles and remaining garlic (about 5 min), then paprika and tomato paste (1 min), then wine (about 3 min). Add the tomatoes (broken up), lamb, and remaining mint and oregano; cook 5-7 min until thick. Discard the cinnamon stick.

Béchamel: melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 min, whisk in the warm milk, bring to a boil and cook about 5 min until pudding-thick; stir in the salt. Off the heat, whisk in the farmer cheese and half the Pecorino; rest 10 min, then whisk in the egg yolks.
Brush a 13x9" pan with 1 Tbsp lamb fat. Layer half the eggplant and half the lamb; repeat. Top with the béchamel and remaining Pecorino.
Bake at 400°F for 30-45 min, until bubbling and browned in spots.
Cool 30 min. (Can be baked a day ahead.)
Brown meat in skillet.
Add Olives, corn, chips, tomato soup, cheese, milk and salsa.
Simmer.
Top with sour cream.

ingredients.name: basmati rice
ingredients.line: 1 cup basmati rice (soaked in water for 1/2 hr)

steps.text: Heat your pot and add ghee, after the ghee is melted add cumin seeds and fry.
Add other spices and fry.
Add soaked rice and fry for 2 min.
Add 2 cups of water. Mix well, add salt, mix again. Dim flame, add lemon juice, stir and then cover.
Let rice cook checking it periodically.
When rice has soaked up all the water and the grains are the right consistency then turn off the heat and let it rest covered for 10 min.
Microwave brown sugar and butter for 2 min.
Add marshmallows.
Microwave until melted, 1 1/2-2 min.
Pour over popcorn.
Mix together, refrigerate and Serve.

ingredients.name: milk chocolate candy bars
ingredients.line: 4 milk chocolate candy bars, coarsely chopped

steps.text: In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup peanut butter, butter, confectioners sugar and salt until smooth; set aside.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, melt the chocolate chips, candy bars and remaining peanut butter; Stir until smooth.
Drop teaspoonfuls of chocolate mixture into paper-lined miniature muffin cups.
Top each with 2 scant tsp of peanut butter mixture; top with another teaspoonful of chocolate mixture.
Refrigerate until set. Store in an airtight container.
Cover cookie sheets with foil, then coat with nonstick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, combine oats, flour, salt and baking powder. Mix well with a wire whisk and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine sugar and butter with electric mixer at medium speed to a grainy paste.
Add egg and vanilla and beat until smooth.
Add flour mixture and blend until just combined.
Drop dough by teaspoons onto cookie sheets 2 1/2" apart.
Bake at 325°F for 9-12 min, until edges begin to turn golden brown.
Let cool, then peel off cookies with your fingers. Be sure to respray the cookie sheets between batches.
Mix above ingredients except whipped cream.
Then fold in whipped cream.
Freeze 6+ hrs before serving in 9x13 dish.
Sift flour and salt together.
Cream butter then add sugar a little at a time. Continue beating until light and fluffy. Mix in egg yolk and almond extract.
Add flour til smooth. Stir in corn flakes and cherry chips.
Use 1 level Tbsp for each cookie. Roll into ball and put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press with fork lengthwise and crosswise. Sprinkle lightly with granulated Sugar.
Bake at 375°F for 12-15 min.
Remove from cookie sheet while still warm.
Melt butter and chocolate.
Beat eggs well, add sugar gradually. Beat well. Beat in chocolate.
Mix in flour with baking powder and salt. Add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in greased 9x9 pan for 25 min.
When cool frost with 1/2 box pwd sugar mixed with 2 Tbsp butter, peppermint extract and milk (enough to make spreadable). Put in refrigerator.
Melt 1 square unsweetened Chocolate with 2 Tbsp butter. Spread on top of mint frosting.
Sift together first 5 ingredients.
Add milk, vanilla, shortening and mix until smooth.
Pour into greased 9x9 pan.
Mix brown sugar and cocoa, sprinkle over batter.
Pour hot water over entire batter.
Bake at 350°F for 40-45 min.
Serve with vanilla Ice-Cream.

recipes.title: Brownies

ingredients.name: quality semi-sweet chocolate
ingredients.line: 8 oz quality semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped

steps.text: Chop chocolate and melt over stove with butter.
Preheat to 350°F.
Cool the mixture and add the sugars, eggs, and all else.
Bake at 350°F for 35 min.

notes: Pan size is not given in the source file.

steps.text: Combine eggs, Carrots, pineapple, sugar and oil. Beat until mixed well.
Add rest of ingredients and pour into large pan. Cook in bundt pan.
Bake at 350°F for 45 min.
For topping combine the topping ingredients and then frost the cooled cake.
Mix 1/2 cup sugar, cornstarch and cinnamon in saucepan.
Stir in peaches and lemon juice. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 min.
Pour into ungreased casserole dish. Keep peach mix hot in oven.
Cut shortening into flour, 1 Tbsp sugar, baking powder and salt until resembles fine crumbles.
Stir in milk.
Drop onto peach mix.
Bake at 400°F for 25-30 min.
Combine eggs and pumpkin.
Combine sugars, salt, and spices - add to pumpkin mixture.
Add evaporated milk gradually, mix til smooth.
Pour into a 9x9 pan.
Top with cake mix and drizzle with butter.
Bake at 350°F for 55-70 min.
Serve with whipped Cream.
Make two recipes of pumpkin pie filling from can.
Pour into 9x13" pan.
Put yellow cake mix on top.
Drizzle butter on top.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hr.
Core apples and pare off 1 in of skin off the sides.
Put butter in the hole in the apple.
Add cinnamon and brown sugar and oats.
Bake at 375°F for 30-40 min, until soft.
Serve with vanilla ice cream.
Mix together crumb mixture, and set aside.
In pan, cook sauce mixture.
Grease 9x13 baking dish and pour 1/2 crumb mixture in bottom.
Pour sauce mixture in baking dish and cover with rest of crumb mixture.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hr.
In a large bowl, measure cereal and set aside.
In a 1 qt microwavable bowl, microwave butter, chocolate chips, and peanut butter on high 1 min. Stir.
Microwave about 30 sec longer or until mixture can be stirred smooth. Stir in vanilla.
Pour mixture over cereal and stir until evenly coated.
Pour into a gallon resealable bag. Add powdered sugar. Seal bag and shake until well coated.
Spread on wax paper to cool. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
In a large pot over stove, heat oil and salt until sizzling.
Add sugar and popcorn Kernels.
Stir to mix and place lid on pot.
Shake occasionally until popping slows.

ingredients.name: large lemon
ingredients.line: 1 large or 2 small lemons, peeled and seeded

steps.text: Blend all ingredients and mix well.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350°F for 35-40 min.
Make stuffing as directed on box.
Press into bottom and sides of muffin tin.
Beat 1 egg with cheese for each tin cup.
Sprinkle with bacon bits.
Bake at 350°F for 10 min.
In a large bowl mix 2/3 cup sugar, yeast, oil, and water until dissolved. Cover and let stand in warm place 15 min.
Blend eggs into yeast mixture.
Add salt to flour and gradually add to yeast to make soft dough.
Knead 5 min on lightly floured surface. Roll into rectangular shape about 1/4 in thick.
Brush dough with melted butter. Combine cinnamon and 1 cup sugar, sprinkle over dough; then add nuts and raisins if desired.
Carefully roll up dough and cut 1" slices with string or knife.
Place on 2 greased 9x13 pans (optional: melt extra butter in each pan and sprinkle with brown sugar first). Let rest 10 min.
Bake at 425°F for 10-15 min, until golden brown.
Frost.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Mix ingredients and pour into a 9x13 pan.
Bake at 400°F for 30 min.

recipes.title: Hawthorn St. Marion Berry Coffee Cake

steps.text: Mix topping ingredients and set aside.
Mix together cake ingredients and pour into well greased 10" Spring form pan.
Pour 3 cups frozen berries on top, cover with topping.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hr.
Put melted butter in a bowl, add brown sugar and oats.
Cover the bottom of a 9x13 pan with fruit.
Pour the oatmeal mixture on top.
Bake at 350°F for 20-25 min.
Serve warm.
Mix all ingredients.
Pour into pie pans that either have been sprayed or Contain melted butter in them.
May prep pans with oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nuts if wished.
Bake at 400°F for 15 min.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Use a 2 Tbsp Scoop to make 16 rounds on wax paper about 2" apart.
Lay another sheet of wax paper on top and mash each patty to a 1/4 inch thickness.
Cook and serve, refrigerate for 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months.
Leave out the egg and mix the remainder of the ingredients.
Brown and use in your favorite recipe or freeze for ready to use Sausage Crumbles.
Put all ingredients in blender and blend til mixed.
Cook as you would a, very thin pancake.
Serve with Snow and Streams (pwd. Sugar and lemon juice).
In a heavy cast-iron 10 1/2 inch Skillet Sauté apples in butter. Sprinkle with Cinnamon and add brown sugar. Cook over medium heat until apples are transparent.
In a blender, mix the rest of the ingredients.
Add blended mixture to hot Skillet.
Place Skillet in oven and bake at 400°F for 25 min.

ingredients.name: yeast bread dough or beer bread dough
ingredients.line: yeast bread dough or beer bread dough

steps.text: Grease a baking dish, it could be a 9x9 or 9x13 or bunt pan.
Form the dough into balls and put butter on each one.
Set balls into the pan and as you are doing that, sprinkle the remaining ingredients on each piece of dough.
Bake at 375°F until done.
Mix eggs, milk, and vanilla.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top of mixture and then dip both sides of the bread slices into it.
Cook on Stove top until both sides are browned.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Melt butter in each pan.
Mix eggs, vanilla, salt, milk, and flour.
Pour into pans.
Bake at 400°F for 15-16 min.
Serve with snow and Streams (pwd Sugar and lemon juice).

recipes.title: Breakfast Cookies

steps.text: Mix like any cookie dough. If desired, add more milk to make cookies thinner.
Bake at 350°F for 12-15 min.

notes: These freeze fine. Just warm up in microwave.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, this is an approximate
ingredients.line: 1 tsp salt (to taste, this is an approximate)

ingredients.name: room temperature ghee
ingredients.line: 3 Tbsp room temperature ghee (aka clarified butter)

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.line: 2 eggs or 2 cups room temperature yogurt

steps.text: Mix water, yeast and sugar together in a large bowl, cover and let sit for 10 min to check yeast.
In a separate bowl combine flour and salt.

After the 10 min are over add the ghee and yogurt to the liquids and then little by little add the flour mixture. We want a sticky dough so add more egg or yogurt if needed to insure the dough is a very sticky dough.
Cover the dough and let rise in a warm place for 15 min.
After 15 min put oil all over your hands and grease a bowl then form the dough into 9 balls and place them in the bowl to rise another 15 min.
Preheat the oven with baking tray in it to 500-550°F (260-290°C).
Take a ball of dough and dust well with flour, roll into a circle, fold 2x to make a triangle, reroll, then brush with olive oil and put garlic on top.
Bake on preheated baking sheet in center of oven until Naan is nice bubbly then move baking sheet to top of oven and turn oven to Broil until the top is nicely browned.
After taking the Naan out of the oven put butter on top and then continue with the next 8 balls.

recipes.title: Vanilla Butter Frosting

steps.text: Mix powdered sugar and margarine.
Stir in vanilla and milk; beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

notes: Spread over tray of Hot cinnamon rolls and frosting will melt on like a glaze.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Mix the flour, shortening, and salt with a pastry blender.
Beat together the egg, vinegar and cold water. Add to the flour mixture, mixing well, but do not Knead.
Divide the dough in half. Roll on a floured surface until large enough to fit on a 9" pie plate.
Carefully place the dough in the pie plate, crimping edges.
Bake at 400°F for 12-15 min, until golden brown, or use with any pie or quiche filling according to the directions.
Toss apples and flour together.
Place the apples in a prepared crust.
Mix sugar, egg, vanilla and sour cream together, pour over apples.
For crumbs, mix oats, sugar, flour, butter, baking powder and soda together until nice and crumbly.
Spread on top of pie.
Bake at 350°F for 40 min.

recipes.title: Baking Powder Biscuits
recipes.source: Scan 25.jpeg, Scan 26.jpeg, Baking Powder Biscuits (Google Doc)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Cut shortening into flour, baking powder, and salt with a pastry blender until mix resembles fine crumbs.
Stir in just enough milk so the dough leaves the side of the bowl.
Turn dough into a lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 10 times.
Roll 1/2" thick, cut into circles and place onto an ungreased cookie sheet with sides touching.
Bake at 450°F for 10-12 min, until golden brown.

ingredients.name: Jiffy corn muffin mix
ingredients.line: 1 (19 oz) box Jiffy corn muffin mix

steps.text: In bowl prepare corn muffin mix following directions on box.
In another bowl make cake mix following directions on box.
Combine two mixes, mix well.
Pour into 9x12 pan.
Bake at 350°F for 30-35 min.
Mix ingredients and put in greased Standard bread loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 30 min.
Add butter over top.
Bake 10 more min.
Best eaten HOT!
Combine cocoa powder, sugar, salt, flour and baking soda.
In a separate bowl combine milk (or yogurt), oil (or melted shortening), eggs, vanilla, and water.
Combine the dry and liquid ingredients, beat until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured 9x13 inch pan or two 9 inch round layer pans.
Bake at 325°F (162°C) for 1 hr.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Beat together the eggs, 2 1/2 cups white sugar and vegetable oil.
Add in milk, salt, baking powder, poppy seeds, vanilla, almond flavoring, and flour. Mix well.
Grease baking pan, either a loaf pan or a 8x8 inch pan.
Pour into pan.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hr (loaf pan) or about 45-55 min (8x8 inch pan).
The tops should be browned and a toothpick inserted in the center should come out clean.
Let cool to a warm temperature then remove from pans.

notes: The original recipe left the bake times blank; the times above are estimates based on similar poppy seed bread recipes and are not confirmed. Similar recipes divide this amount of batter between two loaf pans.

steps.text: In a medium bowl, combine 3 Tbsp Sugar, salt, Cumin, cinnamon, ginger, and Cayenne.
Heat peanut oil in a large Skillet over high heat; add pumpkin Seeds and remaining sugar.
Cook until Sugar melts and pumpkin seeds begin to caramelize, about one min.
Pour seeds in bowl with spices. Stir well to coat; let cool. Store in an airtight Container.
Combine milk, pumpkin and sugar in a pot over medium heat.
Stir until Steamed and remove from heat.
Add pumpkin pie Spice and blend 10 sec or until foamy.
Pour in mug and add espresso.
Boil water and milk.
Add the rest of the ingredients and boil.
Steep 3-5 min.
Brew tea very strong in a half gallon of boiling water. Let it brew longer than you usually do, so it will be very strong.
Remove tea bags and pour tea into gallon pitcher if you haven't already done so.
Add sugar and lemon juice; stir until dissolved.
Add 1/2 gallon of cold water to pitcher or until full. Serve over ice.
Heat the water in a heavy-bottom pan over low heat. Add the sugar and stir until it has completely dissolved. Bring to a boil, remove the pan from the heat and set the syrup aside to cool.
Stir the lemon juice and rind into the syrup.
Pour the mixture into a freezerproof container and place in the freezer for 3-4 hrs.

To serve, remove the container from the freezer and dip the base into hot water. Turn out the ice block and chop Coarsely, then place in food processor and process until it forms small crystals (granita means "granular").
Spoon into Sundae glasses and Serve immediately.

recipes.title: White Peach Sangria

ingredients.name: sweet white wine
ingredients.line: 1 (750 ml) bottle sweet white wine (moscato is fine)

ingredients.name: peach schnapps
ingredients.line: 1 cup peach schnapps (or peach flavored vodka)

ingredients.name: grapes
ingredients.line: 1 cup grapes, halved (could use frozen grapes)

steps.text: In a large pitcher, combine the wine, Schnapps, and fruit. Place in the fridge to chill for at least 2 hrs (or overnight) for flavors to develop.
Chill the Seltzer Separately. Immediately before Serving, Stir in the Seltzer. Serve and enjoy!

notes: To Keep the Sangria cold at a party, you can also use frozen fruit (freeze sliced peaches and grapes for about 20 min) instead of ice, so it doesn't get watered down.

ingredients.name: ginger root
ingredients.line: 1 inch ginger root, peeled and sliced

ingredients.name: frozen mango
ingredients.line: 1 cup frozen mango (fresh is fine too)

steps.text: To peel the ginger use the back of a spoon or a vegetable peeler, just peel the part that you will be using. Using a sharp knife slice ginger into 3-4 coin sized slices. You want them about the size and thickness of the coin.
Drop into your pitcher and add in the mango.
Top with 3 cups ice and then add the water. (The ice is important, it holds down the ginger and mango to help infuse the water).
Place in your fridge for 1-3 hrs before serving.
When serving add a couple frozen mango chunks in a pretty glass for ice cubes.
Combine wine and cider in a pitcher.
Add chopped apples and clementines.
Add cranberries.
Stir well.
Chill until serving.

recipes.title: Apple Cider
notes: The source file lists ingredients only.
